The new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are now available for pre-order. Apple unveiled the new phones on Wednesday, highlighting a variable aperture camera system, a smaller Dynamic Island, and four brand-new colour options.

  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro at Apple
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro Max at Apple
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro at Walmart
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro Max at Walmart

You can now pre-order the iPhone 18 Pro

As a refresher, here are some of the highlights of the iPhone 18 Pro series:

  • A new main camera with variable aperture for greater control over light and depth of field.
  • The new A20 Pro chip, with 50% more memory bandwidth and 40% faster GPU performance.
  • The Dynamic Island has gotten smaller and can now display three Live Activities at once.
  • Battery life gets a major boost. The iPhone 18 Pro can last up to 24 hours in real-world use, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max can last up to 30 hours.
  • A new-generation vapour chamber delivers better thermal performance for improved sustained performance.
  • Faster wired charging: 50% in 15 minutes.

The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max come in four colour options:

  • Bordeaux
  • Glacier Blue
  • Blue White
  • Black

The iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max starts at $1,299. Base storage is 256GB, upgradable to a maximum of 2TB. Purchase options include paying in full, Apple Card or carrier instalment plans, as well as the new Apple Upgrade programme.

The first batch of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max pre-orders will arrive next Friday (September 18). The next pre-order wave will be the iPhone Duo, which opens for pre-order on October 16 and ships on October 23.

Will you be pre-ordering the new iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max? Or are you waiting for the iPhone Duo? Let us know in the comments.
